objective: Find and repair the local source defects that prevent the AI Commander and release control plane from completing exact-SHA staging validation. Reproduce authorization, registry, queue, executor, credential, reconcile, runtime-identity, and evidence failures locally before any Cloudflare proof.
interfaces: Preserve existing command, registry, queue, executor, reconcile, runtime-identity, and immutable-evidence schemas unless an additive compatible change is explicitly required.
Keep exact-SHA identity and failure classifications machine-readable and backward compatible.
constraints: ChatGPT remains the top-level command center; the Local Runner implements, checks, and returns evidence without becoming a second command center.
Do not change model selection, model routing, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare deployment, production, databases, migrations, secrets, DNS, Access, permissions, customer sends, or external sends.
Continue corrections in the same task and isolated worktree; preserve valid prior-pass edits and never restart merely to hide a failed pass.
starting_state: Start from the exact base SHA in a clean isolated worktree. Existing source and contracts are authoritative unless the objective and acceptance criteria explicitly require a bounded compatible change.
acceptance_criteria: All configured local deterministic checks pass from the exact base SHA.
Known authorization-before-create and authorization-before-reconcile failures have regression coverage.
Missing or insufficient credentials fail with a layer-specific code and never become an opaque failed state.
No production, Cloudflare deployment, GitHub Actions, secret, DNS, Access, database, customer-send, or external-send mutation occurs.
The runner creates one local candidate commit and immutable local evidence bound to that exact candidate SHA.
commit_message: feat(debug-fabric): add local AI Commander debug candidate
